backlogged.summary: In lib/verify.mjs the new line `const flaky =[...new Set(...)]` lost the space after `=`. This is a stray formatting change on an existing line and should be restored.

A cache hit found by commit does not compute or store the `tree` key, so an old commit-only entry is never upgraded with a tree. Reuse then only works through the post-merge head entries or through fresh runs. This is harmless, but the tree key could be backfilled on a commit hit.

The post-merge head count store runs `git rev-parse` and `ls-tree` once more after verification. When `ls-tree` fails, a second `tree key` warning is added on top of the one from the base lookup. ES-1 only specifies one warning for the lookup path, so this is not a violation.
